show.description: A disgraced math genius, hiding as a janitor, uses his extraordinary calculation skills to save the woman he loves from a ruthless underworld. To raise ransom, he enters the stock market, turning a single rupee into a massive fortune. With silent precision, he rises to power and begins destroying his enemies’ financial empires.
